newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Tuesday's settlement day on profit-taking in blue chips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 3.47 points, or 0.23 percent, down at 1,528.34 amid 185 losers and 59 gainers in a provisional turnover of 44 million.
Market sentiment remained slightly bearish, one dealer said.
Shell Pakistan fell two rupees to 237 and Pakistan State Oil two to 308. PTCL rose 0.65 to 24.30 and Adamjee Insurance three to 116 at the 0904 GMT close.
